output.summary: Perennial herb native to south-central Europe, the Mediterranean, Central Asia and Iran. It has soft, hairy, heart-shaped leaves with a mild lemon scent and small white or pale pink flowers. It is used raw or cooked in foods and teas, including fish dishes and pesto.
output.edibilityNote: Used raw or cooked in foods and teas, including ice cream, fish dishes and pesto.
